title: Alternate Postweld Heat Treatment Requirements for Carbon and Low Alloy Steels, P-Nos. 1 and 3

columns.header: Minimum Holding Time at Decreased Temperature, h [Note (1)]

notes: (1) Times shown apply to thicknesses ≤25 mm (≤1.0 in.). Add 15 min/ 25 mm (15 min/1.0 in.) of thickness for control thicknesses >25 mm (>1.0 in.) (see para. 331.1.3).
(2) A decrease >55°C (>100°F) below the minimum specified temperature is allowable only for P-No. 1, Group Nos. 1 and 2 materials.
